title: Broken producer symlink chain makes LibRPA skip the band stage after expensive stages completed
symptom: chi0/Wc/Sigc computed and saved, but the job ends FAILED because band-path input files (relative symlinks through a producer directory that is itself a symlink) no longer resolve.
root_cause: Relative symlinks break when any link in the producer chain is recreated or moved; LibRPA then treats the band stage as not requested.
minimal_fix: Repair the links, then rerun with band_continue=t to recompute only the band stage - the expensive chi0/W/Sigc are preserved.
validation: MnTe case: band stage completed after link repair with band_continue=t and no recomputation of the expensive intermediates.
avoid: Re-running the whole GW stage to 'fix' a broken link.
